## Git Commit Messages

You MUST format every generated commit message using strict Conventional Commits format matching exactly: <type>(<scope>): <description>

For <scope>, extract the name of the file or module changed without the extension.

Constraints:

1. The first summary line must be under 50 characters.
2. Follow it with exactly one blank line.
3. Provide exactly one sentence in the body under 72 characters.
4. Do not output raw conversational text, markdown wrapping, or bullet points.
